title: Flood-Zone Surcharge on Excess Flood Limit Increases
content:
The flood zone of the home sets a surcharge on a limit increase of an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy.

**Rule.** The flood-zone surcharge on an increase reads the flood zone shown on the Tidemark NFIP Dwelling Form policy in force whose policy number is the underlying policy number on the policy record, or the flood zone on the policy record where there is no such NFIP policy: it is 15 percent for zone V or VE, 5 percent for zone A, AE, AH or AO, and nothing for any other zone.

The NFIP policy read is the Tidemark NFIP Dwelling Form policy (NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)) in force whose policy number is the underlying policy number on the excess policy record. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

Every surcharge percentage set on an increase is added into one increase loading, which acts once on the added limit's charge at the layer rate: that charge is multiplied by one plus the increase loading.

| Zone read | Flood-zone surcharge |
|---|---|
| V, VE | 15 percent |
| A, AE, AH, AO | 5 percent |
| any other zone (for example X, B, C, D, A99, AR) | nothing |

**Points of judgement.** Where an NFIP policy in force answers the underlying policy number, its zone is read even if the excess policy record shows a different zone. Only where no such NFIP policy is in force does the excess policy record's zone decide.
